name: delay_ms
comment: r0 = milliseconds; called between AT1846S writes (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_apply_cal_table
comment: writes 23 AT1846S registers (addresses at 0x18000808..0x1800081F) from RAM table 0x03050608 + 46*r0; r0 = 0/1 (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_init
comment: AT1846S cold init: soft reset, clock, AGC page-1 table, calibration (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_tune
comment: per-channel apply: spur reg 0x05 by frequency, 0x29/0x2A frequency, DMR branch (0x58=0xBCFD) or FM branch at 0x2FF2 (0x58=0x8405) (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_dmr_filters_bcfd
comment: movi r1,0xBCFD (imm16 LE at +2) for reg 0x58 in the DMR branch: emphasis, voice LPF and RX CTC HPF bypassed, voice-HPF field 01 (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_fm_filters_8405
comment: movi r1,0x8405 (imm16 LE at +2) for reg 0x58 in the FM branch: pre/de-emphasis and voice LPF on, voice-HPF field 01 (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_set_squelch
comment: writes reg 0x49 (squelch close) from two level bytes (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_set_ctcss_dcs
comment: CTCSS/DCS set-up: regs 0x4A-0x4E, 0x3A, 0x59, 0x58 (0x8404/0x8405, bit 3 cleared at 0x3332) (ch. 11 §21)

name: rf_state_0_1
comment: role not read; called with 0/1 around AT1846S reg 0x30 changes at 0xB00C/0xB048 (ch. 11 §21)

name: uart_rx_task
comment: waits for 0x68; 0x20/0x0F discarded, 0x21 -> family_21, else phone_dispatch (ch. 11 §14.1)

name: family21_dispatch
comment: 0x21 sub-command dispatcher, 35 entries via RAM table 0x030520D8 (ch. 11 §14.1)

name: set_tx_gain_reg44
comment: 1-byte body -> AT1846S reg 0x44 bits 11:8 (TX/mic gain), low byte forced 0xFF (ch. 11 §21; likely cmd 0x2A MIC)

name: reply_build
comment: (cmd, sr, body*, len) -> 68 cmd sr 00 ck ck len body 10 (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: cmd34_version_reply
comment: copies 17 B from RAM 0x03052464 (pool word at 0xA9E8; filled outside the image) and replies (ch. 11 §21)

name: phone_dispatch
comment: validate frame, switch(cmd-0x22) via RAM table 0x03052240 (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: memcpy
comment: dst r0, src r1, len r2 (ch. 11 §11.6)

name: ext_at1846_write
comment: external: AT1846S register write, r0 = register, r1 = 16-bit value (ch. 11 §21)

name: ext_at1846_read
comment: external: AT1846S register read, r0 = register, returns value (ch. 11 §21)
